### Hardware support report

In Thermal Ops, start **Monitor only**, wait for detection, then click **Hardware support request**.
Review and copy the report, then paste it below. You can also collect a report after a failed discovery if an identity is available.

<!-- Paste the report here. Do not attach saved profiles, passwords, IP addresses or raw logs. -->

### What would you like to do?

Describe the missing monitoring or cooling feature and what the app currently shows.

### Physical cooling arrangement

Are GPUs cooled by chassis fans? Is this a rack/tower server, blade/enclosure, or local PC?
Do not try undocumented fan commands to gather this report. A report identifies candidates for investigation; it does not by itself verify safe control or automatic restoration.
